d: Amphitheatre filled with Spectators. Royal loggia in the middle. Heraclides in the royal loggia. Elpenore in action to crown the genuflesso Clearco in an athlete's figure, but covered with an overcoat. Various confused and despondent Athletes on one side, and on the other. Choir of Agrigento Men.
Egesta, followed by the choir of the Agrigentine Women, is advanced to the nod of Eraclide already descended from the royal loggia, and having to the right Clearco.
A secluded place at the temple. Cleon. Choir of Priests.
Heraclide. Hegesta. Clearch crowned. Part of the Choir of Agrigento men. Soldiers, and sayings.
Heracles. Cleon. Choir of Agrigento men. Soldiers. Choir of Priests.
Sea beach. Storm with thunder, and hail.
Soldiers, say.
Vestibule of the temple of Jupiter. Choir of priests withdrawn there; then Clearch.
Choir of Priests, then Cleon.
Sacred wood adjacent to the temple. Clearch walking melancholic among the trees, now discovered, now hidden from them. Choir of Priests; then Cleon.
Cleone, then Heraclide, aspasia.

Beach. Sea in calm, and serene sky. We see the five ships already disjoined by the one of Aspasia. They all land at once; Locresi, and Philosses the last of these. Come to the lido Heraclide, Aspasia, Clearco. Choir of Agrigentini. Soldiers.
Aspasia, Clearco, Locresi.
Royal apartments. Egesta. Defile.
Heraclid, choir of women, sayings.
Interior of the temple of Jupiter. Statue of the nume and plow with fire. Cleon. Choir of Priests.
Heraclide. Hegesta. Clearch. Aspasia. Deifile. Philossino. Choir of Agrigentini, Men, and Women. Choir of Locresi. Said.
Cleon, choir of priests.
Royal gardens with mazes, fountains and statues. Clear, then Aspasia.
Clearch; then Philossino.
Philossino; then Cleone.
Uncultivated place, and open, scattered with various ancient mounds. Viewed far away of some ruined temple.
Heraclide, Aspasia, Egesta, Philosses, Cleone, Soldier, said.
Priestly apartments. Cleon. Choir of Priests.
Clearo, that's it.
Clearo, then Aspasia.
Cleone.
Aspasia.
Room of the palace. Eraclide. Egesta. Philosses. Cleone. Deifles. Elpenore. Choir of Agrigentini. Choir of Locresi.
Alcéo. Aspasia.
